blocks.spoken: Want to learn Jiu-Jitsu on the mountaintop? I'm Sandy. Come see me in Tannersville. I'll help you learn four key spots. You'll learn where you are and what to try. Start with one free class.

We start with a free fifteen-minute visit. We talk about your goals. I show you the room and the rules. You can choose to train that day. I confirm your class and when to arrive. You can choose a later class. For the visit, wear your day clothes. To train, bring clean sports clothes. Follow the class plan I send you.
blocks.overlay: Meet Sandy. Plan your first class.

blocks.spoken: We learn standing. Both people are on their feet. I help you find your base. We learn the guard. One person uses their legs to make space. The other works to get past the legs. I show you what each person can try.

blocks.purpose: Chest to chest and chest to back
blocks.spoken: We learn chest to chest. One person holds from the top. The other works to make space. We learn chest to back. One person has control from behind. The other works to turn and face them. I show each spot. You name it and tell me your goal. We try one task with my help.
blocks.overlay: Chest to chest • Chest to back

blocks.spoken: I match your partner and the pace. You can ask me to show a step. You can choose live partner practice. You can pause or end a round at any time. We work on one clear task. I watch you try and help with the next step.

Your first class is free. If you choose to keep training, we review the paid plans and prices. Your next three classes use the paid plan you choose. Our aim is four classes in your first two weeks. Each class has one main spot to learn. Your free class counts as class one. We choose dates that fit your plan and have space. We check what you know as you learn.
blocks.overlay: 1 free class + 3 on your paid plan

blocks.spoken: If your child wants to learn, we can talk about their goals. I teach kids and teens, and I help new adults start. We can plan the right class for each of you.
Come meet me and see the room. Ask for your free first visit. Tell me if you want to train that day. I'll confirm your class and when to arrive. Start calm. Train smart.
